title: Show keyboard focus
summary: A state prefix changes a style when an element is in that state.
introduction: A state prefix changes a style when an element is in that state. Your task: Use Tab to move focus onto the button.
learningObjectives: Use Tab to move focus onto the button.
Explain the example for show keyboard focus

blocks.text: A state prefix changes a style when an element is in that state. focus-visible is useful for a clear keyboard focus mark.

These examples use Tailwind CSS 4 in a separate project. Install tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/cli. Put @import "tailwindcss"; in input.css and build with npx @tailwindcss/cli -i input.css -o output.css. Link output.css in HTML.

blocks.code:
<button class="rounded bg-blue-800 px-4 py-2 text-white hover:bg-blue-900 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-4 focus-visible:outline-blue-800">
  Read a story
</button>

items: `outline-offset` leaves space between the control edge and its outline, so the focus mark is easier to see.

blocks.text: The button darkens on hover and shows a visible outline during keyboard focus.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not remove focus outlines without a clear replacement. A keyboard user needs to see the current control.
